title: Audit Lens: operator access mapping & temporal grant explorer prototype
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Design a compact, searchable Audit Lens component for the Redwood Console that surfaces who has access to a resource, why they have it (role, group, direct grant, inherited), and how long that access lasts. Scope includes: workspace/org role mapping, temporal grants visualization, one-click access simulation, and an exportable incident snapshot for audits. This ticket covers the low-fidelity to interactive prototype, engineering handoff artifacts, and a first round of moderated usability tests with platform engineers and security reviewers.
decision_log: 2026-02-21: Chose a single-column primary view with left rail filters to preserve vertical density for long audit timelines.
2026-02-25: Decided to show inferred inheritance separately from explicit grants to reduce false positives during access reviews.
2026-03-02: Agreed on export schema (CSV + JSON snapshot) with security team; retention metadata must be redacted by default.
2026-03-05: Scoped out automated cross-checks with rollout history; will surface candidate fallback model suggestions in a follow-up ticket.
comment_history: Ava Chen (2026-02-20): Created ticket and attached initial discovery notes from customer interviews with three enterprise accounts concerned about ephemeral keys.
Mateo Rivera (2026-02-23): Posted initial lo-fi screens. Noted performance trade-off for expanded timeline queries; suggested server-side paging of event stream.
Lina Gupta, PM (2026-02-24): PM review — request to prioritize 'who-can' flows in the first pass and add linkouts to role definitions in the console glossary.
Devon Park, Eng (2026-02-26): Engineering note — backend will provide 'grant provenance' field; needs API contract upsert by ENG-7801.
Security Review (2026-03-01): Security asked for automatic redaction of email/PII in exported snapshots. Added to decisions.

User Testing (2026-03-04): 5 participants from Platform and SRE teams. Key friction: confusion between 'inherited via group' and 'temporary direct grant'. Proposed microcopy changes and hover explanations.
Mateo Rivera (2026-03-08): Updated prototype with temporal heatline and an inline simulator to preview the effect of revoking a role. Requested design review with PM and Security.
Lina Gupta, PM (2026-03-10): In review — Approved visuals, asked to create a follow-up ticket for rollout gating and telemetry (metrics to emit for access-review actions).
usability_findings: Participants expect one-click path from an audit row to the roles editor — add contextual quick actions.
Temporal grants need clearer visual affordance; color and label alone were insufficient for users skimming long timelines.
Exported snapshots should include the console URL and model version for reproducibility during incident review.
next_steps: Finalize API contract in ENG-7801 and confirm index strategy for timeline queries.
Create ENG ticket to add redaction flags on export endpoints.
Ship interactive prototype to 'Console Design Review' on 2026-03-12 and gather sign-off.
Split rollout gating and telemetry into PM-1210 (rollout gating) and ENG-7923 (telemetry events).
Prepare developer Handoff doc: assets, component specs, tokenized copy, and accessibility checklist.
